canonical_claim: A source-selected oscillatory matrix Riemann-Hilbert problem can be transformed by the Deift-Zhou nonlinear steepest-descent procedure into model and small-norm problems whose solution yields a quantified long-time asymptotic formula for the associated integrable evolution. The exact 1993 theorem, data, region, leading term, and error bound remain to be selected and independently reviewed.
